feeds.title: 2Summer
feeds.description: My name is Heather Mason and I'm an American Photographer based in Johannesburg. I write a blog called 2Summers. I've developed a passion for Johannesburg that I've never felt for any other place. I tell stories about life in Joburg and my travels around South Africa and the rest of the world.

feeds.title: Wandering Thru Blog
feeds.description: A boutique safari company specializing in custom-made and private guided safaris to East, Southern, and Central Africa. Follow our blog to keep up with our wild adventures, stories from the wild, travel news, and great offers available!.

feeds.title: David Rogers Photographic Blog
feeds.description: David Rogers has been writing and taking photographs in Southern and East Africa for 30 years as a staffer for Getaway and as a photojournalist for Africa Geographic and other publications. He hosts photo workshops in many of Africa's wild places and designs itineraries for photographers.

feeds.title: Monica Dart Photography Blog
feeds.description: I'm Monica. I've been completely enchanted with photographing people throughout my 16 years as a professional photographer.

feeds.title: Roxanne Davison Photography Blog
feeds.description: Roxanne Davison Photography is situated in Hillcrest, Durban, KwaZulu-Natal, South Africa. We travel to capture weddings and portraiture locally and abroad! RD photography specializes in artistic portraiture and wedding photography in both contemporary and classical genres.

feeds.title: Coba Photography Blog
feeds.description: Coba is based in Cape Town, South Africa. She is a wedding photographer & educator to fellow photographers. Learn more about what it's like to work with her, read the reviews, frequently asked questions, and find out if you're a 'Coba Photography Couple.'

feeds.title: Rich Photography Blog
feeds.description: We are wedding photographers based in Johannesburg, South Africa, and we specialize in Wedding Photography, Lifestyle shoots, Fashion, and Events.

feeds.title: Vizion Photography & Films Blog
feeds.description: We capture the magic of the day as it happens. Our style can be described as effortless elegance, as we focus on capturing the real moments and emotions. The experience of having a friendly, professional photography and videography team is just as important as the gorgeous images! We are there to make your experience fun and easy, while capturing oh-so-glamorous images and films!

feeds.title: Abigail Smith Photography Blog
feeds.description: I am a self-taught photographer, I love to challenge myself creatively and believe that growth should be the only constant. I love emotion and my vision is to find better ways to draw it out and document it. I absolutely dislike writing bios. I prefer to tell stories with pictures.

feeds.title: Vitabella Blog
feeds.description: I'm Chantel - a Professional Wedding And Portrait Photographer, Living In Beautiful Durban, South Africa. I offer a classic contemporary style of photography, whether you are looking for a wedding photographer for your big day, maternity photographs, a styled engagement shoot, or some family portraits.

feeds.title: DGR Photography Blog
feeds.description: My name is Dean, I am truly a romantic at heart and love sharing in all the special moments in life!!My approach is clean, elegant, and romantic. I will always go the extra mile to make each and every beautiful couple happy.

feeds.title: Sparkle Photography Blog
feeds.description: My name is Kobie van Rensburg and I am a Cape Town-based Family and Wedding Photographer. I have a passion for people, photography, and natural light. Affordable prices and a unique style. With a hint of sparkle.

feeds.title: Pangolin Photo Safaris Blog
feeds.description: Pangolin Photo Safaris was born out of the principle that 'Everyone Is A Photographer'. At Pangolin Photo Safaris we pride ourselves on catering for wildlife photographers of all levels of experience and ability.

feeds.title: Peartree Photography Blog
feeds.description: Wil Punt is a Stellenbosch based Photographer. Here you will find the best Wedding Photography, natural Lifestyle Family Photography, modern Architectural and Interior Photographer, professional Portraiture and Top Headshots, leading Commercial, Industrial and Corporate Event Photography posts from top work we have done over the years in the Stellenbosch, Paarl, Wellington, Franschhoek and Cape Town area.

feeds.title: Klaus Tiedge Fine Art Wildlife Photography Blog
feeds.description: Embracing the 'modern digital darkroom', Klaus has successfully traversed the boundaries between painting and photography. Klaus displays the distinct ability to give equal attention to the animals and the environment in which they are captured.

feeds.title: Craig Fouché Photography Blog
feeds.description: Blogs by Craig Fouché Photography on various topics regarding all aspects of photography and his own experiences. Craig Fouché Photography is a photographic business based in the Western Cape of South Africa, shooting film and digital medium. Also photographing locally and abroad.

feeds.title: Kyle Kingsley Blog
feeds.description: Kyle Kingsley is a 27-year-old professional photographer originating from Cape Town, South Africa. In addition to servicing private and commercial clients' photographic needs alike, Kyle's focus has shifted toward building a meaningful and longstanding fine art photography print collection.

feeds.title: Rensche Mari Blog
feeds.description: My mission is to photograph my couples in a way that shows the connection they have with one another and to translate their story into a beautiful keepsake album. By far the most rewarding part of shooting a wedding is giving that album to the client it brings your story to life.

feeds.title: RENPHOTOS Blog » Professional Wedding Photographer
feeds.description: Professional Wedding event and lifestyle photographer based in Benoni, Joha.

feeds.title: Snap That Blog
feeds.description: SnapThat is a photography and video company based in Durban that specializes in Media, Corporates, Weddings, and events in South Africa.

feeds.title: Duane Smith Photography Blog
feeds.description: A Destination Wedding & Elopement Photographer Located in the beautiful Somerset West Cape Town, South Africa. Passionate about capturing life's Honest & Grand moments that exist and take place between epic people!

feeds.title: Elysian Photography Blog
feeds.description: I am a photographer based in Empangeni, KwaZulu-Natal, South Africa. I do photoshoots in and around the Zululand area which includes Richards Bay. Using my knowledge of light and position, I can create opportunities to freeze life in its tracks.
